content.title: WEIRD TRICKS YOUR {{GRANDMA}} SWORE BY
facts: Hiccups – Swallow a **teaspoon of sugar** to reset the vagus nerve.
Nosebleed – Pinch the **soft part of your nose** and lean forward for five minutes.
Muscle Cramp – Pinch your **upper lip** firmly for thirty seconds to release the spasm.
Bad Breath – Chew a **whole clove** to neutralize odor-causing bacteria.
Sunburn Sting – Pat on **cooled black tea** to calm redness with its natural tannins.
Canker Sore – Rinse with **warm salt water** to reduce swelling and speed healing.
Toothache – Dab a little **clove oil** on the spot for its natural numbing effect.
Hangover Headache – Sip **ginger tea** to settle the stomach and ease head pressure.
